hypotheses.K1_edge_decomposition_is_exact: Summed edge deltas and QK1/QK2/value Shapley terms reconstruct every affected attention-write delta within 1e-5 relative error.
hypotheses.K2_direct_source_edges_are_nontrivial: Edges directly from the edited source account for at least 10% signed target projection in at least one layer on both corpora.
hypotheses.K3_value_changes_drive_an_early_layer: The value/OV Shapley term carries at least 50% signed attention-delta projection in at least one of layers 0-3 on both corpora.
hypotheses.K4_both_qk_forms_are_used: Each QK form carries at least 10% absolute signed projection in at least one layer on both corpora.
hypotheses.K5_a_recurrent_head_dominates_some_layer: One head is the largest absolute contributor in at least 30% of examples at some layer on both corpora.
hypotheses.K6_three_heads_can_explain_half_a_layer: The three largest absolute head projections sum to at least 50% in at least one layer on both corpora.
